entities.name: MAP2K1 (MEK1)
observations: The 393-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Rattus norvegicus UniProt Q01986, with 100% identity and coverage.
MAP2K1 is a dual-specificity kinase in the MAPK/ERK cascade that phosphorylates ERK1/2 on threonine and tyrosine residues.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 43.46 kDa; theoretical pI 6.19.
